value: seed germination tested under light and dark; temperature influenced germination more than light did
method: laboratory germination trials of seeds under varied temperature, light, pH, drought stress, salinity, heat and smoke

source.authors: Florentine S, Weller S, King A, Florentine A, Dowling K, Westbrooke M, Chauhan BS
source.title: Seed germination response of a noxious agricultural weed Echium plantagineum to temperature, light, pH, drought stress, salinity, heat and smoke

conditions: var. membranacea (POWO treats it as a synonym of C. palustris var. palustris)

source.title: Effect of Light Condition, GA3 and Temperature of Geminator on Seed Germination of Caltha palustris var. membranacea Turcz

quote: Seeds which were not soaked in a 100 mg·L-1 GA3 solution for 24 hr did not germinate either in dark or light.

value: negative photoblastism: light inhibits seed germination, in Chilean and Californian populations alike
method: germination of seeds from native (California) and invasive (Chile) populations along altitude, at the soil surface and buried
conditions: germination zero at the soil surface, higher when seeds were experimentally buried
